title: Fix right menu not reducible
summary: The right settings panel (#right-panel) never collapsed: its author display:flex rule overrode the UA stylesheet's [hidden]{display:none}, so the panel rendered VISIBLE at page load and toggleRightPanel() — which only flips .hidden + main.rp-open — never visually collapsed it. Fix (server repo): #right-panel[hidden]{display:none} author rule (same pattern as .side-panel[hidden] / #ctx-menu[hidden]), pinned in right-panel.test.mjs.

checks: (1) boot: #right-panel hidden + computed display:none (the VIS-002 regression — pre-fix display:flex won)
(3) View-tab toggle collapses again: display:none, rp-open removed
(5) clicking the active rail icon collapses the panel (reducible)
